usage: corvint-mcp --root ABSOLUTE_ROOT [--protocol-version 2026-07-28|2025-11-25]
       corvint-mcp --root ALIAS=ABSOLUTE_ROOT [--root ALIAS=ABSOLUTE_ROOT ...]
       corvint-mcp --root ABSOLUTE_ROOT --follow-ref REF
       corvint-mcp --root ALIAS=ABSOLUTE_ROOT ... --follow-ref ALIAS=REF [--follow-ref ALIAS=REF ...]
       corvint-mcp --workspace FILE [--follow-ref ALIAS=REF ...]
       corvint-mcp ROOTS... --tool-profile LIST [--corpus-artifact [ALIAS=]PATH]
       corvint-mcp --version
A local read-only stdio MCP server. Each --root must be an absolute path to a Git worktree.
One plain --root that does not exist serves the Git worktree enclosing the launch directory, with a notice.
--follow-ref keeps a detached linked worktree on the commit REF names, moving it before each call;
with aliased roots, ALIAS=REF selects the root that follows and the others serve their checkout.
--workspace reads the corvint-workspace/0 declaration FILE and serves each alias as --root ALIAS=ROOT.
--tool-profile LIST is a comma list of the profile flows
and the groups test-validity, test-evidence, docs and corpus; corpus needs --corpus-artifact, a path relative
to the root (ALIAS=PATH with aliased roots). Without --tool-profile the default tools are listed.
Example: corvint-mcp --root /absolute/repo --tool-profile flows
